name: phone

source.prompt: One realistic unbranded modern smartphone with pearl anodized metal edge, a black glossy glass screen, viewed almost front-on and slightly tipped counterclockwise. The screen is blank. Fine camera aperture at top. No case, typography, UI, app icons, video or play icon. Full continuous silhouette.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
